# fondaco_feed (Resource)

One feed: what it proxies, what it hosts, who may read and publish, and how it behaves in a federation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A proxy feed: cache Maven Central, open to everyone inside the network.
resource "fondaco_feed" "central" {
  name      = "central"
  format    = "maven"
  upstream  = "https://repo1.maven.org/maven2"
  anonymous = true

  # Only these coordinates may pass, whatever the upstream offers.
  policy {
    name = "allowlist"
    config = jsonencode({
      allow = ["com.example:*", "org.slf4j:*"]
    })
  }
}

# A hosted feed: our own releases, published by CI only, immutable once
# published.
resource "fondaco_feed" "releases" {
  name       = "releases"
  format     = "maven"
  hosted     = true
  anonymous  = true
  publishers = ["token:ci-*", "project:platform/*"]

  # Serve artifacts as pre-signed redirects instead of streaming them.
  redirect     = true
  redirect_ttl = "15m"
}

# A feed homed at another site: reads are served here, writes are forwarded to
# where the feed lives, and its blobs arrive before anyone asks for them.
resource "fondaco_feed" "eu_releases" {
  name             = "eu-releases"
  format           = "npm"
  hosted           = true
  anonymous        = true
  publishers       = ["project:eu/*"]
  publish_policy   = "forward:eu"
  replication_mode = "eager"
  peer_fallback    = true
}

# A group: one URL for clients, over everything the site holds. Order is
# precedence — the hosted feed comes first, so an internally published
# coordinate wins over a public one of the same name. The documents that list
# versions are merged across members, so neither hides the other.
#
# A group cannot proxy or host itself; it is a view.
resource "fondaco_feed" "maven_public" {
  name      = "maven-public"
  format    = "maven"
  anonymous = true
  members = [
    fondaco_feed.releases.name,
    fondaco_feed.central.name,
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `format` (String) Package format module, e.g. `maven`, `npm`, `nuget`, `composer`, `terraform`. Changing it changes how every stored path is interpreted, so it replaces the feed.
- `name` (String) Feed name, lowercase alphanumeric with dashes. It is the first path segment clients use, so renaming it is a new feed, not an edit.

### Optional

- `anonymous` (Boolean) Allow unauthenticated reads. Defaults to `false`.
- `hosted` (Boolean) Accept locally published packages. Requires a database.
- `members` (List of String) Makes this feed a **group**: a read-only view over these feeds, in this order, so one URL serves both what the site hosts and what it proxies.

Order matters — an artifact comes from the first member that has it, which is how an internal package takes precedence over a public one of the same name. The documents that list versions are merged across members instead, so nothing is hidden. A group cannot have `upstream`, `hosted` or `publishers`; publish to the member that hosts.
- `peer_fallback` (Boolean) Let the read path fetch missing hosted content from peers, hiding replication lag from clients.
- `policy` (Block List) The feed's policy chain, in order. Each block is one policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--policy))
- `publish_policy` (String) Write model in a federation: `forward:<site>` (write-affinity, the default model) or `local` (active-active, conflicts resolved by rule K1).
- `publishers` (List of String) Identity patterns allowed to publish, e.g. `token:ci-*`, `project:group/*`. Requires `hosted = true`; an empty list means publishing is off.
- `redirect` (Boolean) Serve cached artifacts as a redirect to a pre-signed storage URL instead of streaming them. Honoured only where both the storage and the format allow it.
- `redirect_ttl` (String) Lifetime of a pre-signed URL, e.g. `15m`.
- `replication_mode` (String) `eager` (blobs replicate ahead of demand, so the durability watermark is a real RPO) or `lazy` (fetched from peers on demand). Defaults to `lazy`.
- `upstream` (String) Upstream base URL to proxy and cache. Omit for a purely hosted feed.
- `upstream_rps` (Number) Rate limit toward the upstream, in requests per second. `0` is unlimited.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The feed name, which is its identity in the configuration.

<a id="nestedblock--policy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `policy`

Required:

- `name` (String) Registered policy name, e.g. `allowlist`, `osv`, `license`.

Optional:

- `config` (String) Policy options as JSON, usually written with `jsonencode({...})`. The registry validates them; the provider only checks that this is JSON, so a policy it has never heard of still works.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Feeds are imported by name.
terraform import fondaco_feed.central central
```
